scanNote:
Photo File Section, UNIT 13 varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

Yuqorida ko'k sarlavhali quti: 'KEY' (kalit) — 10 ta belgi va ularning ma'nosi.

Pastda 12 ta burj rasmi, har birining yonida UChTA belgi. O'quvchi kalitdan foydalanib har burj uchun bashorat GAPINI yozadi.

⚠ Burjlar tartibi (chap ustun yuqoridan pastga, keyin o'ng ustun):
  Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra,
  Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, Aries

⚠ E'TIBOR BERING: odatda burjlar ARIES (Hamal) dan boshlanadi. Bu betda esa Aries ENG OXIRIDA turibdi, ro'yxat Taurus'dan boshlanadi.

⚠⚠ IKKI JUFT BURJ BIR XIL BELGILAR OLGAN:
  • Virgo va Capricorn — ikkalasida ham: ? + salomatlik + janjal
  • Gemini va Sagittarius — ikkalasida ham: ? + xat + janjal
Bashoratlarni yozganda so'zlarni turlicha tanlash kerak (kalit 'difficult' va 'horrible' — ikkala variantni ham beradi).

⚠ Burj SANALARI kitobda BOSILMAGAN. Quyida berilgan sanalar — qo'shimcha yordam.

⚠ OTA-ONALARGA IZOH: bu — maktab mashqi, maqsadi 'will' bilan kelasi zamon gaplarini mashq qilish. Munajjimlar bashorati haqiqiy ma'lumot emas — kitob uni til o'rgatish uchun o'yin sifatida ishlatgan.

⚠ Unitlar tartibi: 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 5, 6, 8, 8, 11, 12, 13.

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 13 - KEY: use the symbols to write a horoscope for each star sign.
exercises.instructionUz: 13-UNIT — KALIT: belgilardan foydalanib har bir burj uchun bashorat yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — MUNAJJIMLAR BAShORATI.

  Yuqorida KALIT (KEY) — 10 ta belgi va
  ularning ma'nosi.

  Pastda 12 ta burj, har birida UChTA
  belgi.

  Vazifa: belgilardan bashorat GAPI
  tuzish.


KALIT (KEY) — 10 TA BELGI:

  ?  (yashil savol belgisi)
     1  difficult / horrible week
        = qiyin / dahshatli hafta

  !  (qizil undov belgisi)
     2  exciting / pleasant / good week
        = qiziqarli / yoqimli / yaxshi hafta

  Letters (pochta qutisi)
     3  receive a letter/letters
        = xat olmoq

  Invitation (taklifnoma)
     4  get an invitation
        = taklifnoma olmoq

  Mashina
     5  go on a short trip
        = qisqa sayohatga bormoq

  Yugurayotgan odam
     6  have fun
        = ko'ngil ochmoq

  Boshida muz xaltasi bo'lgan odam
     7  have problems with your health
        = salomatlik bilan muammo bo'lmoq

  Qo'l berishayotgan ikki odam
     8  meet an interesting person
        = qiziqarli odam bilan tanishmoq

  Jahli chiqqan odam
     9  argue with someone
        = kimdir bilan janjallashmoq

  Tanga to'la qop
    10  get a lot of money
        = ko'p pul olmoq


⚠⚠ 13-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI — 'WILL':

  Bashorat KELASI ZAMONda yoziladi.

  QOLIP:
     WILL + fe'l (asosiy shakl)

     'You WILL HAVE a good week.'
     'You WILL MEET an interesting person.'

  ⚠ 'will' HECh QAChON o'zgarmaydi:
     I will, you will, he will, she will,
     we will, they will

  ⚠ 'will' dan keyin:
     • 'TO' YO'Q:  'will to have' ✗
     • '-S' YO'Q:  'he will haveS' ✗
     • '-ED' YO'Q: 'will haved'  ✗

  QISQARTMA:
     I will   → I'LL
     you will → YOU'LL
     he will  → HE'LL

  INKOR:
     will not → WON'T
     'You WON'T have problems.'
     ⚠ 'willn't' ✗ — bunday shakl YO'Q!

  SAVOL:
     'WILL you have a good week?'
     ⚠ 'will' oldinga chiqadi.


NAMUNA BAShORAT:

──────────────────────────────────
  TAURUS
  You will have a good week. You
  will get a lot of money and you
  will go on a short trip.

  VIRGO
  You will have a horrible week.
  You will have problems with your
  health and you will argue with
  someone.
──────────────────────────────────


⚠⚠ IKKI JUFT BURJ BIR XIL BELGILAR OLGAN:

  • VIRGO va CAPRICORN
       ikkalasi: ? + salomatlik + janjal

  • GEMINI va SAGITTARIUS
       ikkalasi: ? + xat + janjal

  ⚠ Shuning uchun bashoratlarni yozganda
  SO'ZLARNI TURLIChA tanlang — kalit
  ataylab ikki variant bergan:
     'difficult' va 'horrible'
     'exciting' / 'pleasant' / 'good'


⚠ BURJ TARTIBI HAQIDA:

  Odatda burjlar ARIES (Hamal) dan
  boshlanadi.

  Bu betda esa ro'yxat TAURUS dan
  boshlanib, ARIES ENG OXIRIDA turibdi.


BURJ NOMLARI va SANALARI:

  ⚠ Sanalar kitobda BOSILMAGAN —
  qo'shimcha yordam sifatida berildi.

   1 ARIES        Hamal (Qo'chqor)
                  21-mart - 19-aprel
   2 TAURUS       Savr (Buqa)
                  20-aprel - 20-may
   3 GEMINI       Javzo (Egizaklar)
                  21-may - 20-iyun
   4 CANCER       Saraton (Qisqichbaqa)
                  21-iyun - 22-iyul
   5 LEO          Asad (Arslon)
                  23-iyul - 22-avgust
   6 VIRGO        Sunbula (Boshoq)
                  23-avgust - 22-sentabr
   7 LIBRA        Mezon (Tarozi)
                  23-sentabr - 22-oktabr
   8 SCORPIO      Aqrab (Chayon)
                  23-oktabr - 21-noyabr
   9 SAGITTARIUS  Qavs (Kamonchi)
                  22-noyabr - 21-dekabr
  10 CAPRICORN    Jadiy (Tog' echkisi)
                  22-dekabr - 19-yanvar
  11 AQUARIUS     Dalv (Suvquyar)
                  20-yanvar - 18-fevral
  12 PISCES       Hut (Baliqlar)
                  19-fevral - 20-mart


⚠ 'RECEIVE' va 'GET' FARQI:

  Kalitda ikkalasi ham bor:
     'RECEIVE a letter'
     'GET an invitation'

  Ma'nosi bir xil (olmoq), lekin:
     'receive' — rasmiyroq
     'get'     — oddiy so'zlashuv

  ⚠ 'receive' YOZILIShI: 're-CEI-ve'
  ('c' dan keyin 'ei', 'ie' EMAS!)

  Qoida: 'i before e, except after c'
     believe, friend  — 'ie'
     receive, ceiling — 'ei' ('c' dan keyin)


⚠ 'A LOT OF' — HAMMASI BILAN:

     'a lot of MONEY'   (sanalmaydigan)
     'a lot of FRIENDS' (sanaladigan)

  ⚠ 'much' va 'many' dan farqi: 'a lot of'
  ikkalasi bilan ham ishlatiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a horoscope = munajjimlar bashorati
  a star sign = burj
  a key       = kalit; ochqich
  a symbol    = belgi
  to receive  = olmoq (xat, sovg'a)
  an invitation = taklifnoma
  to invite   = taklif qilmoq
  a trip      = sayohat
  health      = salomatlik
  healthy     = sog'lom
  to argue    = janjallashmoq
  an argument = janjal, tortishuv
  horrible    = dahshatli
  pleasant    = yoqimli
  exciting    = qiziqarli, hayajonli
  to have fun = ko'ngil ochmoq

points.noteUz:
YASHIL savol belgisi.

⚠ Kalit IKKI so'z bergan — 'difficult'
va 'horrible'. Bir xil belgi olgan ikki
burj uchun turlicha yozing.

QIZIL undov belgisi.

⚠ Kalit UChTA so'z bergan —
'exciting', 'pleasant', 'good'.

'exciting' = hayajonli, qiziqarli.

points.en: You will have a good week. You will get a lot of money.
points.uz: Sizni yaxshi hafta kutmoqda. Siz ko'p pul olasiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ 'WILL' + FE'LNING ASOSIY ShAKLI.

  'will have'  ✓
  'will to have' ✗
  'will haves'   ✗

⚠ 'will' hech qachon o'zgarmaydi —
barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil.

points.en: You won't have problems with your health.
points.noteUz:
⚠ INKOR: 'will not' → 'WON'T'.

⚠⚠ 'willn't' degan shakl YO'Q!

Bu — ingliz tilidagi eng g'ayrioddiy
qisqartma.

points.en: Will you go on a short trip?
points.noteUz:
⚠ SAVOLDA 'will' OLDINGA chiqadi:
  'WILL you go...?'  ✓
  'You will go...?'  ✗

⚠ 'do/does' ISHLATILMAYDI:
  'Do you will go?' ✗

points.en: receive a letter  /  get an invitation
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'receive' YOZILISHI: re-CEI-ve.

Qoida: 'i before e, EXCEPT after c':
  believe, friend — 'ie'
  reCEIve, CEIling — 'ei'

'receive' rasmiyroq, 'get' oddiyroq.

points.en: ⚠ Virgo and Capricorn have exactly the same three symbols. So do Gemini and Sagittarius.
points.uz: ⚠ Virgo va Capricorn bir xil uchta belgi olgan. Gemini va Sagittarius ham shunday.
points.noteUz:
⚠⚠ Kitobda shunday chiqib qolgan.

VIRGO va CAPRICORN: ? + salomatlik + janjal
GEMINI va SAGITTARIUS: ? + xat + janjal

⚠ Bashoratlarni yozganda so'zlarni turlicha
tanlang — kalit ataylab ikki-uch variant
bergan.

exercises.instructionEn: Match each star sign with its horoscope.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir burjni o'z bashorati bilan moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
12 TA BURJ — 12 TA BAShORAT.

  Har burjning yonida UChTA belgi bor.
  Belgilardan bashorat gapi tuziladi.


⚠ QOLIP:

  'You will have a [sifat] week.
   You will [ish] and you will [ish].'


⚠ HAR GAPDA 'WILL' TAKRORLANADI:

  'You will get money AND you will go
   on a trip.'

  ⚠ Ikkinchi 'you will' ni tushirib
  qoldirish ham to'g'ri:
  'You will get money and GO on a trip.'

  Lekin boshlovchilar uchun takrorlash
  osonroq.


⚠ BELGILAR TARTIBI:

  Har qatorda birinchi belgi — HAR DOIM
  '?' yoki '!' (haftaning umumiy bahosi).

  Keyingi ikkitasi — aniq voqealar.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun gap ham shunday
  boshlanadi: 'You will have a ... week.'

pairs.right: You will have a good week. You will get a lot of money and you will go on a short trip.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni yaxshi hafta kutmoqda. Siz ko'p pul olasiz va qisqa sayohatga borasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Chap ustun, 1-qator.

Belgilar: ! (yaxshi hafta) + tanga to'la qop
(ko'p pul) + mashina (qisqa sayohat).

⚠ 'a lot of money' — 'money' sanalmaydi,
lekin 'a lot of' ishlatiladi.

pairs.right: You will have a difficult week. You will argue with someone, but you will receive a letter.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni qiyin hafta kutmoqda. Siz kimdir bilan janjallashasiz, lekin xat olasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Chap ustun, 2-qator.

Belgilar: ? (qiyin hafta) + jahli chiqqan odam
(janjal) + pochta qutisi (xat).

⚠ SAGITTARIUS ham AYNAN shu uchta belgini
olgan — shuning uchun so'zlarni turlicha
tanladik ('difficult' va 'but').

pairs.right: You will have an exciting week. You will get an invitation and you will go on a short trip.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni qiziqarli hafta kutmoqda. Siz taklifnoma olasiz va qisqa sayohatga borasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Chap ustun, 3-qator.

Belgilar: ! + 'Invitation' yorlig'i + mashina.

⚠ 'AN exciting week' — unli tovushdan oldin
'an'.
⚠ 'AN invitation' ham shunday.

pairs.right: You will have a pleasant week. You will get an invitation and you will have fun.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni yoqimli hafta kutmoqda. Siz taklifnoma olasiz va ko'ngil ochasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Chap ustun, 4-qator.

Belgilar: ! + 'Invitation' + yugurayotgan odam
(ko'ngil ochish).

⚠ 'to have fun' — artiklsiz.
'a fun' ✗ ('fun' sanalmaydi).

pairs.right: You will have a horrible week. You will have health problems and you will argue with someone.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni dahshatli hafta kutmoqda. Sizda salomatlik muammolari bo'ladi va kimdir bilan janjallashasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Chap ustun, 5-qator.

Belgilar: ? + boshida muz xaltasi bo'lgan odam
(salomatlik) + jahli chiqqan odam (janjal).

⚠⚠ CAPRICORN ham AYNAN shu uchta belgini
olgan! Shuning uchun bu yerda 'horrible' va
'health problems' ishlatildi.

pairs.right: You will have a good week. You will meet an interesting person and you will have fun.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni yaxshi hafta kutmoqda. Siz qiziqarli odam bilan tanishasiz va ko'ngil ochasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Chap ustun, 6-qator (oxirgi).

Belgilar: ! + qo'l berishayotgan ikki odam
(tanishuv) + yugurayotgan odam.

⚠ 'to meet' = tanishmoq; uchrashmoq.

pairs.right: You will have an exciting week. You will receive letters and you will get a lot of money.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni qiziqarli hafta kutmoqda. Siz xatlar olasiz va ko'p pul olasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ O'ng ustun, 1-qator.

Belgilar: ! + pochta qutisi + tanga to'la qop.

⚠ Kalitda 'a letter/letters' — ikkala shakl
ham mumkin.

pairs.right: You will have a horrible week. You will receive a letter and you will argue with a friend.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni dahshatli hafta kutmoqda. Siz xat olasiz va do'stingiz bilan janjallashasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ O'ng ustun, 2-qator.

Belgilar: ? + pochta qutisi + jahli chiqqan
odam.

⚠⚠ GEMINI ham AYNAN shu uchta belgini
olgan — shuning uchun bu yerda boshqa
so'zlar tanlandi.

pairs.right: You will have a difficult week. You will have problems with your health and you will argue with someone.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni qiyin hafta kutmoqda. Salomatligingiz bilan muammo bo'ladi va kimdir bilan janjallashasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ O'ng ustun, 3-qator.

Belgilar: ? + muz xaltasi + jahli chiqqan odam.

⚠⚠ VIRGO bilan AYNAN bir xil belgilar.
Bu yerda kalitning to'liq iborasi ishlatildi:
'have problems with your health'.

pairs.right: You will have a pleasant week. You will get an invitation and you will meet an interesting person.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni yoqimli hafta kutmoqda. Siz taklifnoma olasiz va qiziqarli odam bilan tanishasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ O'ng ustun, 4-qator.

Belgilar: ! + 'Invitation' + qo'l berishayotgan
ikki odam.

⚠ Rasmda ko'zada suv quyilayotgan tasvir —
Aquarius 'suvquyar' degani.

pairs.right: You will have a good week. You will receive a letter and you will go on a short trip.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni yaxshi hafta kutmoqda. Siz xat olasiz va qisqa sayohatga borasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ O'ng ustun, 5-qator.

Belgilar: ! + pochta qutisi + mashina.

⚠ Rasmda IKKITA baliq — 'Pisces' lotincha
'baliqlar' degani.

pairs.right: You will have an exciting week. You will meet an interesting person, but you will argue with someone.
pairs.rightUz: Sizni qiziqarli hafta kutmoqda. Siz qiziqarli odam bilan tanishasiz, lekin kimdir bilan janjallashasiz.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ O'ng ustun, 6-qator (eng oxirgi).

Belgilar: ! + qo'l berishayotgan ikki odam +
jahli chiqqan odam.

⚠ E'TIBOR BERING: Aries — burjlarning
BIRINChISI, lekin bu betda ENG OXIRIDA
turibdi.

⚠ '!' va janjal birga kelgani uchun 'BUT'
bog'lovchisi mos tushadi.
